<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import {
  MenubarRoot,
  type MenubarRootEmits,
  type MenubarRootProps,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
} from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<MenubarRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<MenubarRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <MenubarRoot
    data-slot="menubar"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-menubar"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </MenubarRoot>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-menubar {
    display: flex;
    height: calc(var(--spacing) * 10);
    align-items: center;
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--background);
    gap: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import {
  MenubarContent,
  type MenubarContentProps,
  MenubarPortal,
  useForwardProps,
} from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<MenubarContentProps>(),
  {
    align: 'start',
    alignOffset: -4,
    sideOffset: 8,
  },
);

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <MenubarPortal>
    <MenubarContent
      data-slot="menubar-content"
      v-bind="{ ...forwardedProps, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
      class="sigma-ui-menubar-content"
      :class="[$attrs.class]"
    >
      <slot />
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarPortal>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-menubar-content {
    z-index: 50;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-width: calc(var(--spacing) * 48);
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    backdrop-filter: blur(var(--backdrop-filter-blur));
    background-color: var(--popover);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    color: var(--popover-foreground);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: scale(0.96) translateY(-2px);
    transform-origin: var(--reka-menubar-content-transform-origin);
    transition: transform 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out;
  }

  .sigma-ui-menubar-content[data-state="open"] {
    animation: sigma-ui-menubar-show 150ms ease-out;
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  }

  .sigma-ui-menubar-content[data-state="closed"] {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: scale(0.96) translateY(-2px);
    transition: transform 100ms ease-in, opacity 100ms ease-in;
  }

  @keyframes sigma-ui-menubar-show {
    0% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0.96) translateY(-2px);
    }

    100% {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
    }
  }
}
</style>
